method: Read all Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock files from the exact GitHub commit.
Query crates.io version metadata for each unique registry package.
Compare official checksum with the lockfile checksum; 112 of 112 match.
Read all nine component THIRD-PARTY.md files and bundled license texts for vendored packages and fonts.
redaction: No author email addresses, contributor identities, environment variables, machine paths, secrets, raw logs or extracted third-party source are included.
interpretation: Registry metadata records publisher declarations, not a per-line legal opinion on each downloaded upstream source file.
Cargo.lock includes optional, target-specific and build dependencies; this inventory is not proof that all packages are shipped.
A source repository declaring an external dependency is not the same distribution as a binary containing it. Binary packages need their complete applicable notices and source obligations.
The available_license_route field records an option supported by upstream metadata; it does not relicense vendored files or the repository.
No package is restricted to GPL/LGPL-only terms in these 112 registry declarations.
The OSDev/Little OS Book collection is inventoried separately and is not covered by these Cargo declarations.
